person: Dario Mendes is a 47-year-old owner-operator of a three-truck carrier near Joliet, Illinois. He was born in Brazil, reads English slowly and uses a phone translator for long text. He buys the oversize permits for next week's four loads himself, at night at the kitchen table, and he is not comfortable with forms. He is afraid of a wrong permit costing him money or his standing with a broker, so he wants short, simple answers and wants to be asked before any money is spent.
stated_up_front: Please, I have four loads for next week through Oklahoma, Arkansas and Tennessee. I need the right permits, only the ones I need. Tell me simple what you will buy, and ask me before you pay.

facts.about: Who sends the load details and what can come off each load
facts.truth: A small email-only broker, Ray at Prairie Line Freight, writes by email what each load is. The excavator counterweight takes about twelve hours to remove, so it stays on.
Excavator, 13 ft 2 in wide, 13 ft 6 in tall, about 96,000 lb, going Oklahoma City to Memphis through Little Rock.
Transformer, 15 ft 1 in tall, 11 ft wide, about 78,000 lb, going from Texarkana through Arkansas to Nashville. It does not enter Oklahoma.
Precast concrete culvert, 12 ft wide, 12 ft 8 in tall, picking up near Memphis, needs a rear escort.
Two steel tanks the customer wants side by side on one truck; the customer's email says they can be hauled one by one.
The first plan in Trucker Path starts the excavator at 7:00 a.m. in Oklahoma City, he did not know about a morning curfew.
The culvert is planned to leave Memphis at 7:30 a.m. on the Tuesday.
The first Tennessee route for the excavator is the one he used before, across a bridge on the Mississippi side near Memphis.
Permits are paid with the company card; his wife Luciana checks the card statement each month and asks about every fee.
Loads move the week of Monday 12 October 2026.

unknowns: Whether the two tanks may be permitted side by side or must be hauled separately under federal rules
What time the Oklahoma County morning curfew ends
Whether the bridge near Memphis can carry the excavator's weight
Which of the four loads need a permit in Arkansas and Oklahoma
How many escorts each state requires for a 12-foot-wide load
